comparisons = 0
import heapq
import time


class PriorityRecord:
    __slots__ = ('priority', 'payload')

    def __init__(self, record):
        self.priority, self.payload = record

    def __lt__(self, other):
        global comparisons
        comparisons += 1
        return self.priority < other.priority


def bench(repetitions, values):
    # Records are input setup, outside the timed copy/build/pop task.
    values = list(map(PriorityRecord, values))
    started = time.process_time_ns()
    checksum = 0
    for _ in range(repetitions):
        queue = values.copy()
        heapq.heapify(queue)
        for position in range(1, len(values) + 1):
            checksum += heapq.heappop(queue).priority * position
    elapsed = time.process_time_ns() - started
    print(checksum)
    print(elapsed)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    bench(64, [((i * 73 + 19) % 1009 - 500, i) for i in range(256)])

print(comparisons)

local comparisons = 0
local function less(a, b)
    comparisons = comparisons + 1
    return a[1] < b[1]
end
local function sift_down(queue, parent, size)
    local replacement = queue[parent]
    while parent * 2 <= size do
        local child = parent * 2
        if child < size and less(queue[child + 1], queue[child]) then child = child + 1 end
        if not less(queue[child], replacement) then break end
        queue[parent] = queue[child]
        parent = child
    end
    queue[parent] = replacement
end
local function pop(queue)
    local result = queue[1]
    local replacement = table.remove(queue)
    local size = #queue
    if size > 0 then
        local parent = 1
        while parent * 2 <= size do
            local child = parent * 2
            if child < size and less(queue[child + 1], queue[child]) then child = child + 1 end
            queue[parent] = queue[child]
            parent = child
        end
        while parent > 1 do
            local previous = parent // 2
            if not less(replacement, queue[previous]) then break end
            queue[parent] = queue[previous]
            parent = previous
        end
        queue[parent] = replacement
    end
    return result
end
